summary: Frontend-only testing of Residents self-registration flow (PROPTO). Verified: form-link banner + copy, tab switching with counts, public /join/<token> page loads society info & form, submission creates Pending resident with 'Via Form' badge, Accept moves resident to Active with correct toast ('invite could not be sent — WhatsApp not connected'), Reject removes resident from both tabs, Add Resident dialog works, search + Owner/Tenant filters work.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y minor).

critical_code_review_comments: Residents.jsx: approve/reject use raw api.delete/api.post without passing cfg (society scope); works because backend infers scope from JWT for society admin, but inconsistent with other calls that pass cfg — consider passing cfg for parity/multi-society safety.
DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning) — add DialogDescription to Add Resident and other dialogs.
seed_data_creation: Created test residents via public form (TEST_Rider_*, TEST_Reject_*) and Add dialog (TEST_Added_*). Reject test deleted its record; accept & add records remain in Active for society Green Valley.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows in the review request passed end-to-end on https://complaint-whatsapp.preview.emergentagent.com. Form URL pattern: /join/<token>. Accept shows the exact expected toast when WhatsApp is not connected. No blocking bugs.
